claim: V01 §1.2's hook row (l. 205) reads '| V04 §3.5.4 (item 244's span rule) | a raised part's spans with their `use` (`open`, `vault`) | crossings through `open` spans only (V01 §3.17.3) |'. The span rule's home is the base's §2.7 (l. 2729, '**The span rule**, run eagerly at the end of the raised way's generation …'). V04 §3.5.4 (d) (V04 l. 1689–1690) is a reader of it: 'The base fixes each span's `use` eagerly by §2.7's span rule (item 244)'. This round makes the home matter more. A span's `use` is now read together with §2.7's crossing table (a `vault` span under a wall is read `open`; the span rule 'never reads a wall', l. 2644–2645), and V01 §3.17.3 (3) cites §2.7 for that reading, while the hook row still sends a builder to V04. The repair left the row as it stands, since it cites V01 §3.17.3 for its use; its provider column is the mis-citation. Nothing built changes.
required_change: V01 §1.2's row: "V04 §3.5.4 (item 244's span rule)" → "§2.7's span rule (item 244; a `vault` span under a wall read `open`, §2.7's crossing table, *beneath*)", the other two cells as they stand.
